title: CommandPad
description: A client-side command board for saving and running server commands from an in-game GUI.
body:
**CommandPad is a client-side command board for Minecraft.**

It lets you save commonly used server commands and run them from a clean in-game GUI. Commands are organized per server, so your profiles for one server do not mix with another server.

## Supported Server Presets

- Hypixel

Hypixel includes built-in preset profiles for common game modes like SkyBlock, Bedwars, SkyWars, Duels, Murder Mystery, Build Battle, Arcade, Housing, TNT Games, UHC, and The Pit.

Other servers are still supported with custom profiles. If a server does not have built-in presets yet, CommandPad will create a clean Default profile for that server.

Singleplayer worlds share the same local CommandPad profiles.

## Features

- Client-side only
- Per-server command profiles
- Search commands and profiles
- Create, rename, and delete profiles
- Add custom command tiles with icons
- Reorder command tiles
- Left-click a command to run it
- Right-click a command to edit it
- Built-in Hypixel presets
- Join Discord button

## Safety

CommandPad does not automate gameplay. Commands only run after you manually click a GUI button.
